answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 4208 Country: Pakistan Title: In the present day there is a beloved person of Allah about whom Holy Prophet Hazrat Muhammad (PBUH) ordered in dreams of various people to immediately commence allegiance. Should they? Question: In the present day there is a beloved person of Allah about whom Holy Prophet Hazrat Muhammad (PBUH) ordered in dreams of various people to immediately commence allegiance. Should they? Answer ID: 4208 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 877/762=B/1429) In the abovementioned case, only due to dream one by Shariah is not bound to obey. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
